name: attribution
description: Finds prose in tracked markdown that restates content an external source owns (vendor docs, blogs, articles) without attribution, confirms the source, and converts the copy into a pointer, a citation, or a dated stamped record. Documentation attribution, not software supply chain. Scripts do only mechanical work; judgment is LLM work. Read-only audit by default; explicit fix and sweep actions apply changes behind a semantic-diff guard and live pointer checks.

budgets_searches_per_candidate.title: Searches per candidate
budgets_searches_per_candidate.description: Web searches the audit may run for one candidate. Empty: 3. A repository's attribution.yaml or attribution.local.yaml overrides it.

budgets_fetches_per_candidate.title: Fetches per candidate
budgets_fetches_per_candidate.description: Page fetches the audit may run for one candidate. Empty: 5. A repository's attribution.yaml or attribution.local.yaml overrides it.

budgets_corpus_fetch_ceiling.title: Fetch ceiling per run
budgets_corpus_fetch_ceiling.description: Page fetches allowed across one whole audit or sweep. Empty: 200. A repository's attribution.yaml or attribution.local.yaml overrides it.

judge_samples.title: Judges per candidate
judge_samples.description: Blind judges per candidate. Empty: 3; a value below 3 is raised to 3 for any finding that could become fix-eligible. A repository's attribution.yaml or attribution.local.yaml overrides it.

accuracy_nomination_passes.title: Nomination passes
accuracy_nomination_passes.description: Nomination dispatches per run. Empty: 2. A repository's attribution.yaml or attribution.local.yaml overrides it.

accuracy_judge_lens_diversity.title: Judge lens diversity
accuracy_judge_lens_diversity.description: Give each judge a different lens. Empty: true. A repository's attribution.yaml or attribution.local.yaml overrides it.

accuracy_review_agents.title: Review agents
accuracy_review_agents.description: Adversarial reviewers per copy-rubric STANDS verdict, 0 for none. Empty: 1. A repository's attribution.yaml or attribution.local.yaml overrides it.

accuracy_deep_research_on_exhaustion.title: Deep research on exhaustion
accuracy_deep_research_on_exhaustion.description: Let a budget-exhausted candidate escalate to /discovery:research when that plugin is installed. Empty: false. A repository's attribution.yaml or attribution.local.yaml overrides it.
